raw_text: Those satellite images of Indian LAC construction being pushed by Chinese accounts look manipulated. I ran error level analysis on the Maxar imagery and the bunker structures show completely different compression artifacts from the surrounding terrain. It looks like structures were spliced in from a different location. The shadow angles on the supposedly new buildings don't match the sun position for that latitude and time. Classic image manipulation technique.
clean_text: OSINT analysts detected manipulation in Chinese-circulated LAC satellite imagery through error level analysis. Spliced structures show different compression artifacts and mismatched shadow angles for claimed location.
